Streamers Split On Execution: HasanAbi and Asmongold clash over Nidal Malik Hasan; debate over livestream
articles.description: HasanAbi criticised the reported plan to execute Nidal Malik Hasan by firing squad and livestream the event, calling it “barbaric” and comparing it to the Dark Ages. Hasan, responsible for the 2009 Fort Hood shooting, reportedly faces execution on December 3, 2026. Fellow streamer Asmongold supported the decision, referencing online reactions to Charlie Kirk's 2025 assassination. Their opposing views have sparked debate over capital punishment, justice and political violence.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.description: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback. With a remarkable twelve-hour battery life on a single charge, this device empowers users with greater independence. The project's goal is to enhance the day-to-day experiences of those with vision impairments.

articles.title: Vidyut Jammwal on being typecast in action roles before Street Fighter debut
articles.description: Vidyut Jammwal has revealed that he always wanted to be typecast as an action star in Bollywood. In an interview with Mid-Day, the actor explained why he embraces the label and how it reflects his career ambitions. He also discussed preparing for his Hollywood debut in 'Street Fighter', in which he plays Dhalsim. Directed by Kitao Sakurai, the action film features Noah Centineo, Andrew Koji and Jason Momoa and is scheduled for an October 16 release.

articles.title: Jr NTR wishes SS Rajamouli on 53rd birthday, calls him a man who keeps ‘raising the bar’
articles.description: On SS Rajamouli's birthday, Jr NTR lauded the director's exceptional talent and their enduring camaraderie. He shared a fun snapshot that reflects their longstanding friendship and collaborative history, which includes four blockbuster films, with 'RRR' standing out for its global impact. In the meantime, Rajamouli is busy directing 'Varanasi', featuring stars like Mahesh Babu and Priyanka Chopra Jonas, set to hit theaters on April 7, 2027.

articles.title: Britney Spears drops unreleased song she wrote with Justin Timberlake
articles.description: Britney Spears has delighted fans by releasing an unreleased track, 'She’ll Never Be Me,' dating back to 2001. Co-written with her former partner Justin Timberlake, this song was initially meant for her anticipated third studio album. This reveal coincides with the upcoming 25th anniversary edition of her iconic album 'Britney,' set for November 6, 2026. Fans can look forward to more exciting content as the anniversary approaches.
